newsitem.title: USA: BPA still offers only off-peak power for Monday.
newsitem.headline: BPA still offers only off-peak power for Monday.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) continued to offer only off-peak power for Monday pre-schedulings, but did offer some heavy load hour volumes for Sunday, the agency said Friday.
Monday prices for non-firm power for hours ending at 0600 and 2300 PT were unchanged at $9.50 for all deliveries, while prices for hours ending 0100-0500 and 2400 were steady at $9.00.
Firm power during off-peak hours on Monday was also unchanged at $9.00 per MWh.
Up to 500 MW of non-firm power was offered for Sunday during peak hours (0900-2200 PT) at $13.00 for Northwest deliveries and $14.00 for Calfiornia-Oregon border sales.
